allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Force app, components, lib, public -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($url = "https://music.163.com/api/search/get/web?s=" + [uri]::EscapeDataString\("另一种语言"\) + "&type=1000&limit=30&offset=0"; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Get -Headers @{ "Referer" = "https://music.163.com/"; "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 \(KHTML, like Gecko\) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" } -TimeoutSec 20; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($url = "https://music.163.com/api/search/get/web?s=" + [uri]::EscapeDataString\("With you around 塞壬唱片"\) + "&type=1&limit=30&offset=0"; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Get -Headers @{ "Referer" = "https://music.163.com/"; "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 \(KHTML, like Gecko\) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" } -TimeoutSec 20; $songs = $r.result.songs; foreach \($s in $songs\) { $artists = \($s.artists | ForEach-Object { $_.name }\) -join "/"; "{0} | {1} | {2} | album:{3}" -f $s.id, $s.name, $artists, $s.album.name } } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($url = "https://music.163.com/api/song/enhance/player/url?ids=%5B3373534451%5D&br=320000"; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Get -Headers @{ "Referer" = "https://music.163.com/"; "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 \(KHTML, like Gecko\) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" } -TimeoutSec 20; $r.data | ForEach-Object { "id=$\($_.id\) code=$\($_.code\) size=$\($_.size\) type=$\($_.type\)" ; if \($_.url\) { "url=$\($_.url.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(80, $_.url.Length\)\)\)..." } } } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($url = "https://music.163.com/outchain/player?type=2&id=3373534451&auto=0&height=66"; try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -Method Get -Headers @{ "Referer" = "https://music.163.com/"; "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 \(KHTML, like Gecko\) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" } -TimeoutSec 20; "Status: $\($resp.StatusCode\)"; "Length: $\($resp.Content.Length\)"; $resp.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(1500, $resp.Content.Length\)\) } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($url = "https://music.163.com/outchain/player?type=2&id=3373534451&auto=0&height=66"; $out = curl.exe -s -L -A "Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 \(KHTML, like Gecko\) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" -e "https://music.163.com/" $url; "LENGTH: $\($out.Length\)"; $out.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(2000, $out.Length\)\))
